text:
{
  "units": [
    {
      "id": "tp_cg_001",
      "task_type": "new_file_add",
      "artifact_path": "packages/web/src/common/styles/attendee-status.ts",
      "module": "grid-attendee-badge",
      "depends_on": [],
      "instruction": "Create packages/web/src/common/styles/attendee-status.ts. Import type AttendeeResponseStatus from @core/types/event-attendance.contracts. Export ATTENDEE_STATUS_DOT: Record<AttendeeResponseStatus, string> with mappings: accepted: 'bg-success', declined: 'bg-error', tentative: 'bg-warning', needsAction: 'bg-text-subtle'. Export attendeeStatusLabel = (status: AttendeeResponseStatus): string => status === 'needsAction' ? \"hasn't responded\" : status.",
      "acceptance": [
        "packages/web/src/common/styles/attendee-status.ts is created and exports ATTENDEE_STATUS_DOT and attendeeStatusLabel.",
        "ATTENDEE_STATUS_DOT maps accepted to 'bg-success', declined to 'bg-error', tentative to 'bg-warning', and needsAction to 'bg-text-subtle'.",
        "attendeeStatusLabel returns \"hasn't responded\" for 'needsAction' and the raw status string for all other values.",
        "Type definitions and exports compile cleanly without TypeScript or Biome errors."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "tp_cg_002",
      "task_type": "existing_file_edit",
      "artifact_path": "packages/web/src/views/Forms/EventForm/EventDetailsSection.tsx",
      "module": "grid-attendee-badge",
      "depends_on": [
        "tp_cg_001"
      ],
      "instruction": "Edit packages/web/src/views/Forms/EventForm/EventDetailsSection.tsx to import ATTENDEE_STATUS_DOT and attendeeStatusLabel from @web/common/styles/attendee-status. Remove the local definitions of ATTENDEE_STATUS_DOT and attendeeStatusLabel. Remove the unused import of AttendeeResponseStatus from @core/types/event-attendance.contracts. Keep MAX_VISIBLE_ATTENDEES = 6 and leave all JSX markup and form behavior unchanged.",
      "acceptance": [
        "ATTENDEE_STATUS_DOT and attendeeStatusLabel are imported from @web/common/styles/attendee-status.",
        "Local definitions of ATTENDEE_STATUS_DOT and attendeeStatusLabel are removed.",
        "Unused AttendeeResponseStatus type import from @core/types/event-attendance.contracts is removed.",
        "MAX_VISIBLE_ATTENDEES = 6 is retained and existing JSX rendering remains byte-for-byte identical."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "tp_cg_003",
      "task_type": "new_file_add",
      "artifact_path": "packages/web/src/grid/components/AttendeeBadge.tsx",
      "module": "grid-attendee-badge",
      "depends_on": [
        "tp_cg_001"
      ],
      "instruction": "Create packages/web/src/grid/components/AttendeeBadge.tsx per the plan's TSX skeleton. Import cn from classnames, type Attendee from @core/types/event-attendance.contracts, and ATTENDEE_STATUS_DOT, attendeeStatusLabel from @web/common/styles/attendee-status. Define MAX_BADGE_ATTENDEES = 3 and export AttendeeBadgeProps { attendees?: readonly Attendee[] | null; className?: string }. Export AttendeeBadge component: return null when !attendees || attendees.length === 0. Slice visibleAttendees up to MAX_BADGE_ATTENDEES and compute overflowCount. Compute summaryLabel as `Attendees: ${attendees.map(a => `${a.displayName ?? a.email} (${attendeeStatusLabel(a.responseStatus)})`).join(\", \")}`. Render container with role=\"group\", aria-label={summaryLabel}, and className cn(\"inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 shrink-0 select-none\", className). Inside, map visible attendees to spans with key={attendee.email}, aria-hidden=\"true\", title={`${name}: ${statusText}`}, and className cn(\"size-1.5 rounded-full ring-1 ring-background/60 shrink-0\", ATTENDEE_STATUS_DOT[attendee.responseStatus]). When overflowCount > 0, render an overflow span with aria-hidden=\"true\", className \"text-[9px] font-medium leading-none opacity-80 pl-0.5\", and text `+${overflowCount}`.",
      "acceptance": [
        "AttendeeBadge returns null when attendees is undefined, null, or empty.",
        "Badge container renders with role=\"group\" and aria-label formatted as 'Attendees: <Name> (<Status>), ...'.",
        "Renders at most 3 dot spans with className cn('size-1.5 rounded-full ring-1 ring-background/60 shrink-0', ATTENDEE_STATUS_DOT[attendee.responseStatus]) and key={attendee.email}.",
        "Each dot span has aria-hidden=\"true\" and title={`${name}: ${statusText}`}.",
        "When attendees.length > 3, renders an overflow span with className 'text-[9px] font-medium leading-none opacity-80 pl-0.5' and text `+${overflowCount}`."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "tp_cg_004",
      "task_type": "existing_file_edit",
      "artifact_path": "packages/web/src/grid/components/TimedEventCard.tsx",
      "module": "grid-attendee-badge",
      "depends_on": [
        "tp_cg_003"
      ],
      "instruction": "Edit packages/web/src/grid/components/TimedEventCard.tsx to import { AttendeeBadge } from \"./AttendeeBadge\". Inside the content wrapper div carrying EVENT_CONTENT_ATTRIBUTE, conditionally render {event.attendees && event.attendees.length > 0 && <AttendeeBadge attendees={event.attendees} />} immediately after the time label element and before the resize handles fragment.",
      "acceptance": [
        "AttendeeBadge is imported from './AttendeeBadge'.",
        "AttendeeBadge is conditionally rendered with {event.attendees && event.attendees.length > 0 && <AttendeeBadge attendees={event.attendees} />} inside the EVENT_CONTENT_ATTRIBUTE container.",
        "The badge is placed after the time label and before the resize handle elements.",
        "When event.attendees is undefined or empty, no AttendeeBadge element is rendered."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "tp_cg_005",
      "task_type": "existing_file_edit",
      "artifact_path": "packages/web/src/grid/components/AllDayEventCard.tsx",
      "module": "grid-attendee-badge",
      "depends_on": [
        "tp_cg_003"
      ],
      "instruction": "Edit packages/web/src/grid/components/AllDayEventCard.tsx to import { AttendeeBadge } from \"./AttendeeBadge\". Update the title row container div className to cn(\"flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1\", { \"pr-3.5\": showRepeatIcon }). Render {event.attendees && event.attendees.length > 0 && <AttendeeBadge attendees={event.attendees} />} inline inside that title row div immediately following the title span.",
      "acceptance": [
        "AttendeeBadge is imported from './AttendeeBadge'.",
        "The title row container className is updated to cn(\"flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1\", { \"pr-3.5\": showRepeatIcon }).",
        "AttendeeBadge is conditionally rendered with {event.attendees && event.attendees.length > 0 && <AttendeeBadge attendees={event.attendees} />} immediately after the title span.",
        "When event.attendees is undefined or empty, no AttendeeBadge element is rendered."
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "tp_cg_006",
      "task_type": "test_add",
      "artifact_path": "packages/web/src/grid/components/EventCard.test.tsx",
      "module": "grid-attendee-badge",
      "depends_on": [
        "tp_cg_004",
        "tp_cg_005"
      ],
      "instruction": "Edit packages/web/src/grid/components/EventCard.test.tsx to append tests covering the five plan test cases using bun:test and @testing-library/react: (1) Zero-attendee DOM invariance: render TimedEventCard and AllDayEventCard with attendees: undefined and attendees: [], asserting querySelector('[role=\"group\"]') is null; (2) Badge rendering & status dots: render an event with 2 attendees (accepted, declined) and verify 2 dots with bg-success and bg-error classes and matching title tooltips; (3) Overflow handling: render an event with 5 attendees and verify exactly 3 dots, a '+2' overflow text element, and role=\"group\" aria-label listing all 5 names and statuses; (4) Accessibility contract: verify role=\"group\" and summary aria-label=\"Attendees: ...\" presence; (5) Interaction non-interference: verify firing mousedown on a card rendering a badge still triggers onEventMouseDown and onScalerMouseDown handlers.",
      "acceptance": [
        "Test case verifies zero-attendee invariance with attendees undefined and [] on both TimedEventCard and AllDayEventCard.",
        "Test case verifies 2 attendee status dots render with bg-success and bg-error classes and correct title tooltips.",
        "Test case verifies 5 attendees render exactly 3 dots, a '+2' text indicator, and a complete summary aria-label naming all 5 attendees.",
        "Test case verifies role=\"group\" and comprehensive summary aria-label=\"Attendees: ...\" on the badge container.",
        "Test case verifies onEventMouseDown and onScalerMouseDown continue to fire on card mousedown when a badge is present.",
        "All test suites in packages/web/src/grid/components/EventCard.test.tsx pass successfully."
      ]
    }
  ]
}
